messages:
tess: Quick catch while updating docs: our 429 example assumes Retry-After header only; some proxies return {"retry_after": n} in body. Causing examples to crash.

rahul: Can you paste the minimal failing snippet?

tess: ```python
resp = client.generate(prompt)
if resp.status == 429:
    wait = int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After'))
    time.sleep(wait)
    resp = client.generate(prompt)
```

zane: Yikes. Also saw a context-trim example that slices raw characters and can break JSON outputs. We should show token-aware trimming and a schema-safe fallback.

eng-runtime: Confirmed: older proxies used body.retry_after, newer ones set Retry-After header. We'll add response.retry_in_seconds in next deploy (ENG-RUNTIME-1308). Until then, docs should check retry_in_seconds -> header -> body.

rahul: Plan for PR: update py/js snippets to check three sources, add backoff with capped jitter, include a tiny docker-compose mock_429 for CI smoke tests, and replace naive trim with token-aware helper. I will open branch docs/retry-trim-harness.

qa-bot: QA checklist: unit tests for header/body logic, smoke run against mock_429, and validate trimmed output against a sample JSON schema.

docs-bot: Reminder: add 'docs' label, link ENG-RUNTIME-1308, and include changelog note. Use docs-pr-template.md.

rahul: Opening PR shortly. cc @tess @zane for reviews.
